div.head: II Cn 22.2
div.ab: And gyf þegen hæbbe getrywne man to foraðe for hine, þæt swa sig; gyf he næbbe, ofga sylf his spæce.
⁊ gif þegen hæbbe getrywne man to foraðe for hine, þæt swa sy; gif he næbbe, ofga sylf his spæce.
Si tainus habeat credibilem hominem ad anteiuramentum pro eo, sit; si non habeat, ipse tainus causam suam preiuret.
⁊ gyf ðegen hæbbe getreowe man to foraðe for hine þæt swa sy; gyf he næbbe, ofga sylf his spæce.
And gyf þegen hæbbe getrywne man to foraðe for hine, þæt swa sig; gyf he næbbe, ofga sylf his spæce.
And if a thegn has a trustworthy man to give his oath of accusation for him, he may be allowed to make use of him; if he has not, he must begin his case in person.
And if a thane has a trustworthy man to make a claim on his behalf, he may use him; if he does not, then he must make the claim himself.
And if a thegn has a trustworthy man to give the preliminary oath in his stead, that may be so done; if he has not, he is himself to set on foot his suit.
Und wenn ein Thegn einen glaubwürdigen Vasallen statt seiner zum Klageeid-Leisten hat, so geschehe das also; wenn er keinen hat, beginne er seine Processklage selbst.
And if a thegn has a trustworthy man to swear the fore-oath for him, let it be so; if he has none, let him bring his suit himself.
